# ParallelLingvo

> ParallelLingvo is a multilingual vocabulary learning application. The current application supports Dutch (NL), English (EN), and Russian (RU) in one connected learning flow. It combines vocabulary lessons, translations, pronunciation audio, difficult-word review, and progress tracking in a mobile-first interface.

ParallelLingvo is designed for learners who want Dutch, English, and Russian vocabulary to stay connected around the same concept instead of maintaining separate bilingual decks.

Canonical public website: https://parallellingvo.app/
Learning application: https://learn.iovenko.eu/
Source repository: https://github.com/ViktorIovenko/Learn_English_and_Dutch

## Supported website languages

- English: https://parallellingvo.app/
- Nederlands: https://parallellingvo.app/nl/
- Русский: https://parallellingvo.app/ru/

The website language set mirrors the languages currently supported by the application: NL, EN, RU. Each language has a separate crawlable HTML URL and corresponding hreflang relationships.
